description.en: Notebook reproducibility capture for DeepSeek Harness: reads .ipynb JSON without executing it, reports kernel, cell types, execution order, imports, runtime installs, seeds and paths, hashes the notebook and environment declarations, and writes REP evidence with a record.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Notebook 可复现性采集：不执行地读取 .ipynb JSON，报告内核、单元类型、执行顺序、导入、运行时安装、随机种子与路径，散列 notebook 与环境声明，并写入 REP 证据与记录。
